description: This Java class 'CustomJobParameterResolver' handles retrieval and resolution of custom job parameters within a batch processing context, including fetching parameters from a repository, parsing JSON data, and injecting parameters into execution contexts.

classes.name: CustomJobParameterResolver
classes.description: A Spring component that resolves custom job parameters for batch jobs, fetching data from a repository, parsing JSON, and injecting parameters into execution context.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a specific custom job parameter and puts its value into the step execution context.

methods.name: getCustomJobParameterSet
methods.description: Retrieves a set of JobParameterDTO objects from the custom job parameter repository based on the step execution.

methods.name: getCustomJobParameterById
methods.description: Fetches a specific parameter value by its key from the custom job parameters associated with a step execution.

methods.name: getJobParameters
methods.description: Extracts job parameters from the StepExecution context into an unmodifiable map.
